title: Musk says he will rename SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI
key_facts: Musk confirmed on X, replying to a user: 'Yes, we will make that change.'
He added: 'No more AI. SI, it's better.'
Trump's executive order 'Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence' calls for AI to be referred to as Super Intelligence in public communications, government websites and reports.
Congressional statutory references are exempt until Congress amends them.
SpaceXAI was created in July after SpaceX acquired xAI in a $1.25 trillion deal.
This would be its second major identity change.
quote_evidence: SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI, Musk confirmed in a post on X.
Congressional statutory references remain exempt until Congress passes conforming amendments.
why_it_matters_hint: A government wording order is already changing company names.
notes: Reuters, Forbes and others carry the story; only Fox read.
